_what: The load table. Every fixed reading this record has put on a word of the standing sentence — the sentence's words never changed, so everything a night added to it had to go into what one of its words means. Hand-built, signed; measure.py checks every quote against its source and counts the readings per word.
_criterion: A reading is on this table when a note declares, in its own text, that it is saying what a word of the standing sentence names or does. Findings that stand beside the sentence are candidates, not readings, and live in candidates.json.

readings.quote: "Error" is not the ground; it is the observer's later,
readings.reading: the observer's later, norm-relative reading of a difference — not a property of the system
two species: a present wrong value, and an expected value absent — and the sign that separates them is itself observer-imposed

readings.quote: "Error" is where the observer stands, always was.
readings.reading: a place where somebody stands, not a term in the system

readings.quote: It is an **installed base**: the accumulated
readings.reading: in institutional cases, an installed base holding the norm by inertia, inside what it observes and able to edit it

readings.quote: it names the **role of the imposer**
readings.reading: the role of the imposer — whoever applies the norm to this difference — never the author, publisher or holder of the norm
the temporal index: a difference is an error relative to a moment of reading, and the same difference read later can stop being one

readings.reading: and NOT the genetic claim — the word had annexed a second job, which S71 removed from it and relocated to Session 60's open question
attachment alone — one of five relations a norm stands in to a difference (declared, attached, published, transmitted, acted on)
